description: This bar chart, titled "EssayBench Evaluating Large Language Models in Multi-Genre Chinese Essay Writing," illustrates the sample count for two categories—"Open" (light blue) and "Cons." (pink)—across four essay genres: "Narrative," "Descriptive," and "Expository," with a fourth category partially visible on the far right. The vertical axis, labeled "Sample Count," is scaled linearly from 0 to 200 in increments of 20, with tick marks and labeled values. The horizontal axis lists the genres in the order shown, with labels rotated for readability. Each genre has two adjacent bars: the "Open" bar is light blue and the "Cons." bar is pink. For "Narrative," the "Open" bar reaches a value of 79 and the "Cons." bar reaches 122. For "Descriptive," the "Open" bar reaches 68 and the "Cons." bar reaches 100. For "Expository," the "Open" bar reaches 62 and the "Cons." bar reaches a value exceeding 200, with the exact value obscured by the chart's cropping. The chart includes a legend in the top right corner identifying the light blue bar as "Open" and the pink bar as "Cons." There is no visual sorting of the bars by value, and no bars are emphasized beyond their standard presentation.
